method: Copied the current six-file v3 set into this new external recovery directory through apply_patch without changing the overwritten v3 directory.

Applied the exact inverse of the retained in-context delta: restored the original contract section 8.2 paragraph, original matrix R01 row, removed the added changelog bullet, restored the original receipt artifact sizes and hashes, and restored the original SHA256SUMS entries.
Removed one copy-transport-added final LF from each copied file; every resulting byte length and SHA-256 was then compared with the pre-overwrite identity.
No session, rollout, joblog, secret, browser, Go command, service, SSH, source repository, or production system was read or changed for recovery.

recoveredArtifacts.name: SOURCE-EVIDENCE.txt
recoveredArtifacts.note: This file had not changed in the overwritten directory.

knownGap: The original v3 files were overwritten in place before any independent byte backup was created. This exact post-hoc recovery preserves the old bytes in a new directory but is not evidence that an independent backup existed before the incident.
nextRevisionBoundary: Any corrected contract must be authored in a new v4 directory. Neither this recovery directory nor the overwritten v3 directory may be edited for that purpose.
